inputs.drivers: ESPR and Batteries Regulation; 2027 battery deadline; delegated acts; traceability; registry and API standards; compliance budgets; RFID and QR adoption; enterprise data quality; cybersecurity and interoperability.
inputs.invalidation: Rules slip, open standards commoditise the stack, manufacturers build in-house, data quality delays rollout, or revenue remains immaterial.
inputs.seed_claim: EU Digital Product Passports may create a multi-year partly non-discretionary buildout in product identity, data carriers, lifecycle data, enterprise integration, and compliance services.
inputs.supporting_evidence: The seed states that the central registry and testing environment are live and the first mandatory battery-passport deadline is 2027-02-18.
inputs.value_chain: Digital identification and labels; RFID, QR, NFC, and scanners; ERP, master-data, and PLM software; compliance services; regulated manufacturers, importers, marketplaces, recyclers, and repair networks.

objective: Research one EU Digital Product Passport infrastructure investment idea.
